neighbours.label: The capital word-start piece ' Im' when a name or term splits as Im|... (Im|plantable, Im|reh, Im|ran, Im|plies); quiet on capitalised Im-words that are single tokens (Imagine, Imperial, Impact, Imaging, Implement).
fire: The hospital opened a new unit for Implants and Prosthetic Surgery last spring.
Cited works: Novak, P.; Imreh, L.; Szabo, K. Annals of Biology, 1998.
The new cricket academy is named after Imran Khan, who won the World Cup.

predictions: median fire ~0.35 (probes: Im|plantable 0.59, Im|reh 0.50, Im|ran 0.28, Im|plies 0.27); near misses < 0.1 (single-token Im-words are untested; Cardiac Devices 0.05). A.D.A.M. '.D' reached 0.30, so the pole also takes other initial pieces.
notes: Card: ' Im' x5, ' im' x2, 'Im' x2, '.D' x4, mostly in citation/medical/math contexts. Tokenizer: Implants, Implied, Imogen, Imreh, Imran split as ' Im'+rest; Imagine, Imaging, Impact, Imperial, Implement, Implicit, Imam are single tokens.
